artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Extends HVST-h-4's module without editing its functions' behaviour. New: GOLD_DAILY_TABLE='chatter_daily', BACKFILL_FLOOR=2026-01-01, ENABLED_PUBLISHERS (sorted(SOURCE_FOR_PUBLISHER): barrons/bbg/ft/sa/wsj), GOLD_DAILY_SCHEMA; daily_rows(mention_rows, securities, start, end, coverage) -- PURE, dense one row per (security, day), articles_total/tier_a..d/mention_score/mention_count_total/publishers_distinct, trailing_7d_sum/trailing_30d_sum floored at start, baseline_30d_sum/baseline_30d_days (30 days before the trailing-7 window), cumulative_ytd (resets per calendar year), first/last_published_utc, data_status (COMPLETE/PARTIAL/DENIED); _day_of places a row by published_utc.astimezone(UTC).date(), never a naive .date() read; publisher_coverage(listing_hit_rows, securities, run_status=None) derives {security_key:{publisher_code:(span_start,span_end)}} from listing_hit rows matched to a security by word-bounded search_query (_listing_hit_security_match, same shape as the harvester floor); _iter_all_listing_hits reads EVERY listing_hit row across all 5 sources directly from parquet (store.silver_latest's per-key latest-only collapse would drop every hit sharing a page's dedupe key but one); _latest_gold_snapshot_rows(table) reads the newest date= partition's newest part file for any full-snapshot gold table; build_daily(securities, as_of_date, client=None) wires these together and write_gold gained an optional schema= parameter (default GOLD_MENTION_SCHEMA, so every pre-existing call site is byte-for-byte unchanged) so the daily table can be written under GOLD_DAILY_SCHEMA. New CLI subcommand build-daily --securities-json FILE --as-of YYYY-MM-DD.

New file, exactly the ten arms section 1 item 3 names: test_dense_zero_rows_for_empty_days, test_row_count_is_days_times_securities, test_published_utc_places_the_day, test_offset_timestamp_lands_on_utc_day, test_trailing_sums_inclusive, test_baseline_short_at_start, test_cumulative_ytd, test_absolute_only_columns, test_data_status_complete_partial_denied, test_rebuild_identical. Pure fixtures throughout; no network, no live bucket.
